result.summary: The page looks generally functional and well-structured. One minor visual issue was identified.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel appears to be truncated mid-word ('Trattoria Piccolo' or similar), cutting off the full name without an ellipsis or any visual indicator that the text is truncated.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and a fixed width to restaurant name labels in the carousel cards so truncation is visually communicated clearly, or increase the card width to accommodate the full name.
